capabilities: Show daily tasks and projects on cards
Track habits with weekday or custom schedules
Edit daily or monthly journal entries
Display reading highlights and WeRead exports
extras: Core dashboard works offline with no telemetry; creator sync needs Ego Lite and has only been tested on macOS (Apple Silicon); AI reflections may incur charges from the configured provider.
problem: Obsidian has no single place to see today's tasks, habits, journal status and reading progress together.

relations.evidence: Install Ego Lite yourself and sign in to the desired creator platforms in its browser.
To fetch official highlights and comments, select your own WeRead API key

summary: Customizable local dashboard tab that organizes daily tasks, projects, habits, journals, reading and finances from your own Markdown notes.
